Who We Are
 We are searching for a technical expert and leader to be responsible for guiding the aXet.code and aXet.desktop teams in defining the technical approach, particularly by providing technical support and guidelines, coordinating with functional and development teams to ensure consistent, maintainable deliveries within established deadlines.
 What You'll Be Doing
Analyze, design, implement, and test developments for the aXet.code CLI application and aXet.desktop, as well as maintenance for a plugin for VSCode
Participate in the code review of other team members, ensuring quality and adherence to development best practices
Identify and resolve issues or blockers that may arise during development
Provide training and support to less experienced developers, especially in Go, React, and TypeScript
 What You'll Bring Along
BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related field
Minimum 6+ years as a Software Developer
Strong knowledge and skills in Go, React, and TypeScript, as well as experience integrating services and APIs for CLI (Command Line Interface) implementations and desktop applications
Experience implementing AI technologies and working within their development ecosystem, including LLMs, MCPs, Skills, and Agents
Strong communication and technical documentation skills
Experience in estimating and sequencing development tasks
Familiarity with agile methodologies and project management tools
Proven experience developing desktop and CLI solutions
Ability to solve problems efficiently and proactively
Advanced English proficiency, with the ability to communicate independently, both verbally and in writing, with different audiences and stakeholders
Nice to Have:
Knowledge of front-end frameworks such as Angular
